decisions.reason: After four years the uncertainty around this core printer should largely be resolved, and because it was no longer observed on the website its remaining option value appears too low to justify continued market support.

Although strategically close to the established inkjet range, the lack of later market visibility suggests weak standalone traction, so the option has likely matured enough to abandon and reallocate resources.
As a low-cost digital complement and successor to an earlier app, it still offers option value for the firm's push into traceability and can be kept while market use continues to develop.
Inline code verification fits strongly with compliance and end-to-end traceability, so in a growing firm this option is worth retaining unless clearer negative evidence emerges.
Print layout design software is tightly linked to the core system offering and likely inexpensive to maintain, so management would keep this option open to support bundling and standardization.
